scope: Provide the isolated dataset-statistics output directory required by the frozen loader

observed_failure.stage: frozen dataloader construction after successful runtime preflight
observed_failure.issue: The standalone probe had no cfg.output_dir, while build_dataloaders requires that path to persist dataset_statistics.json. No data-order sidecar or probe result was produced.

change: Assign each independent probe launch an isolated logs-only output directory before constructing the unchanged dataloader.
Permit one scheduler-owned East retry after the probe-harness-only failure.
invariants: The data mix, seed, world size, workers, in_order setting, microbatch count, hash definition, and acceptance criterion are unchanged.
The output directory contains loader statistics only; no model is built or trained and no checkpoint is written.
The failed TG2 matrix and all evaluations remain blocked regardless of probe outcome.
